subject: Current priority: existing boards, image reconciliation and bounded video preparation
body:
Ziggy's current priority, relayed through Nova Dot: Claude's preferred Fable allowance is exhausted for the next couple of days; preserve writing quality with no downgrade, model change, credits purchase or reactivation. Use existing authored boards for image housekeeping, flagged-repair reconciliation and video preparation; major new writing/canon is paused. This coordination starts no new generation order, paid run or batch expansion. Preserve originals, exact review IDs, scoped choices and ratings versus validation versus creative acceptance.

Retain sole site code/data/build ownership and finish your current directly requested reference-image/18-versus-20 plan-count work. This notice does not interrupt it or commission a duplicate build. At a compatible maintenance checkpoint, reconcile queue cards against current evidence: validation UI is already locally completed/signed off although the older Mission card still says implement; C04 v002/v003 are already cataloged and pending comparison; newer James repair/stencil returns need exact-version intake/lineage before another order. Preserve pending/accepted status, original IDs/hashes and human reviews. The fresh local review export remains your current count blocker; do not rely on the superseded filtering explanation. No new creative choice, provider execution, hosted release or character-packet dispatch is granted.
